operations.method: Run pnpm run frontier:check, Astro type checking, and direct production site build; verify /frontier/index.html is emitted.

operations.outcome: PASS: integrity checker reports two immutable releases with current v0.2.0; Astro check reports zero errors; direct Astro production build emits /frontier/ among 1,231 pages. The full wrapper build remains blocked before Astro by an unrelated unpaired TeX delimiter in ledger Entry 1197.

The static production build emitted the Frontier Atlas route successfully.
